args.assumptions: Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha; largest 8-connected parcel is 58.31 ha, so infeasible and yield set to 0 per the rule (clear-sky yield for 30 MW not computed). Suitable = landcover in {cropland 1, scrub 2} AND Horn slope <= 5 deg (cell-centre threshold, inclusive) AND NOT inside designation A buffer (150 m) or designation B buffer (400 m), where buffers were applied per designation and judged at cell centres AND cell centre within 5 km of the 132 kV HV line (all 14,400 cells are within 1.83 km, so this constraint excludes nothing). DEM has no nodata cells, so no nodata exclusions were needed. Grid is 120x120 at 25 m (0.0625 ha per cell). Protected polygons themselves lie within their buffers and are excluded. Forest, water and urban cells are excluded. Area = 3759 cells = 234.94 ha. Patches counted with 8-connectivity (18 patches).

Required land = 30 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 48 ha. Suitable cells: landcover cropland (1) or scrub (2); Horn slope <= 7 degrees (inclusive); DEM has no nodata cells so none excluded; not within 250 m of designation A polygons (PA-1, PA-3) or 600 m of designation B (PA-2), buffers computed in EPSG:32630 and judged at cell centres (all_touched=false); distance to 132 kV line judged at cell centres. Max distance to line on the grid is 1828 m, so all cells satisfy the 5 km limit and this criterion is non-binding. Contiguity 8-connected; largest parcel 198.19 ha across 8 patches. Yield is pvlib clear-sky Ineichen upper bound for 30 MW, fixed 30 deg tilt, PR 0.80, not a bankable estimate. Mask layer suit_mask (largest patch in suit_largest).

Site is infeasible: a 50 MW plant needs 100 ha at 2 ha/MW, and the largest 8-connected suitable parcel is 57.94 ha (15 patches total), so the yield is reported as 0 per the rule. Data prep: the DEM uses -9999 as its no-data value (808 cells) and I declared it as no-data before computing slope; cells touching no-data are excluded by the slope step. Slope is Horn-method degrees and the criterion is slope <= 5 degrees (inclusive). Buildable land is landcover class 1 (cropland) or 2 (scrub) only. Protected-area exclusion: every protected polygon (designations A and B, 300 m buffer each) was buffered by 300 m and rasterized on cell centres. The 8 km line limit was tested on cell-centre distance to the 132 kV line; the maximum distance on the grid is about 1.83 km, so this constraint excludes nothing. Suitable mask = cropland/scrub AND outside protected buffers AND slope <= 5 deg AND within 8 km of the line. Cell area is 0.0625 ha (25 m cells). The clear-sky yield was not computed because the feasibility rule sets it to 0.

Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha. Suitable = cropland or scrub AND slope <= 5 deg (Horn, degrees, 25 m DEM) AND cell centre within 8 km of the 132 kV line (max distance in the grid is ~1.83 km, so all cells pass) AND cell centre not inside the 300 m buffer of any protected area (A or B; both use 300 m, buffered after repairing the self-intersecting PA-2 polygon via fix_geometry). No DEM nodata cells existed, so no nodata exclusions were needed. Forest, water and urban excluded. Contiguity is 8-connected. Largest parcel 57.94 ha is below the 60 ha requirement, so the site is infeasible and the energy yield is set to 0 (the clear-sky figure for 30 MW at tilt 30 deg, PR 0.80 was 56.5 GWh, shown only for reference and not reported). Area computed at 0.0625 ha per 25 m cell.

Required land = 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Suitable = slope <= 8% (Horn slope, percent) AND landcover in {cropland 1, scrub 2} AND outside designation A buffer (152.4 m = 500 ft) and designation B buffer (396.24 m = 1300 ft), with protected-area and buffer cells judged by centre (rasterized centre-in, not all-touched) AND centre within 4828 m (3 mi) of the 132 kV line. No DEM nodata cells existed, so no nodata exclusions applied. The line-distance criterion was non-binding: all cells lie within 1828 m of the line. Slope edge cells use the tool's default edge handling. Parcels by 8-connectivity: 21 patches, largest 53.0 ha, which is below the 80.94 ha required, so the site is infeasible and yield is set to 0 (the clear-sky yield tool was not run since the site fails the feasibility test).

Required land = 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Largest 8-connected parcel is 52.81 ha (18 patches total), so the site is infeasible and yield is set to 0 per the brief. Site is not feasible: the largest contiguous parcel (52.5 ha, 8-connected, 18 patches) is below the 80.94 ha required (50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres).
